title: Why precise and accurate requirements mattered before AI
caption: Every product translates an intent. How well that translation is written down decides the result.
label: Four boards: precise and accurate, precise only, accurate only, neither

a-new-pain.title: An old pain
a-new-pain.script: Think of the last time you got back exactly what you asked for, and it was still wrong. Nobody was lazy and nothing was broken. The building went fine, so the failure sat somewhere else, and that is the pain this Section is about.

where-the-section-goes.title: Where the Section goes
where-the-section-goes.script: We take three steps. First what value actually is, then where it splits into two halves, and then what makes a requirement a good one.
